scope: Interim implementation review before UAC and final generation

open_findings.problem: A missing registry skips consumer-declaration validation and lets canonical loading fall through to detached receipt verification. A self-consistent copied schema and receipt in the canonical consumer source is accepted without registry authority.
open_findings.reproduction: Construct owner/consumer fixture, resolve valid bundle, copy effective resource and receipt into canonical consumer, delete .meta/shared-resource-imports.json. validate_shared_resource_imports returns {}; load_capability_bundle returns identical prior hash.
open_findings.required_repair: On missing registry, scan/reject any declared shared imports or canonical receipt before build writes; canonical resolution must never use a detached receipt as import authority. Preserve legacy no-import behavior.
open_findings.required_regression: Missing registry with importing map must fail in preflight before output writes, both with absent imported bytes and with a self-consistent forged canonical bundle.

open_findings.problem: Regex over encoded JSON misses escaped $ref keys, admitting references outside the explicitly closed shared-resource package.
open_findings.reproduction: Use valid JSON {"\u0024ref":"https://example.invalid/external-schema"} as owner schema, update pinned digest, resolve consumer. Assembly succeeds.
open_findings.required_repair: Check decoded JSON object keys recursively for unsupported JSON Schema reference keywords, including escaped spellings. Reject unsupported reference closure consistently; standard library only.
open_findings.required_regression: Nested/escaped $ref and $dynamicRef inputs fail closed; real SpecContract schema and ordinary imported text remain supported.
